repos.name: NVIDIA/auto-ontology
repos.description: Auto Ontology is a Python framework for building semantic, graph-based reasoning layers over data. It enables deterministic query generation, better context retrieval, and more explainable AI for LLM and agent workflows.
repos.eli5: It builds a map that tells AI where data lives and what it means, like a library catalog that helps a robot find the right book and understand its story. Developers and AI engineers use it to make smarter, more trustworthy assistants.

repos.name: mattpocock/skills
repos.description: Skills for Real Engineers. Straight from my .agents directory.
repos.eli5: These are tiny cheat‑sheets that teach AI helpers how to do real engineering tasks, like a pocket guide for a robot builder. Engineers who use AI assistants add them to their projects.

repos.description: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA

repos.name: D4Vinci/Scrapling

repos.description: Computer use CLI for AI agents

repos.name: lz4/lz4
repos.eli5: It squishes files super fast so they take up less space, like packing a suitcase tightly without folding anything wrong. Programmers and anyone who stores lots of data use it.

repos.name: google/skills
repos.description: Agent Skills for Google products and technologies
repos.eli5: These are ready‑made instructions that let AI bots use Google services, like a recipe book that tells a robot how to bake a cloud cake. Developers building AI agents for Google products use them.

repos.name: vercel-labs/agent-browser
repos.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
repos.eli5: It lets an AI open a web page and click around by reading a simple text map of the page, like giving a robot a floor plan so it can walk through a house and press switches. AI developers who need web automation use it.
